infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Veynlo uses Face ID to keep your inbox locked when you're not using the app.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Veynlo uses the camera to scan receipts and other documents.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Veynlo uses your photo library so you can attach an existing photo as a document.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Veynlo reads your device calendar so its events show up alongside everything else Veynlo tracks.
infoPlist.NSRemindersUsageDescription: Veynlo reads your Reminders app so your tasks show up alongside everything else Veynlo tracks.

plugins.photosPermission: Veynlo uses your photo library so you can attach an existing photo as a document.
plugins.cameraPermission: Veynlo uses the camera to scan receipts and other documents.

plugins.calendarPermission: Veynlo reads your device calendar so its events show up alongside everything else Veynlo tracks.

plugins.contactsPermission: Veynlo reads your contacts so you can choose which ones to import as people you're tracking. Nothing is imported without your confirmation.

plugins.microphonePermission: Veynlo uses the microphone to record voice notes you can capture into your inbox.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Veynlo uses your location, only while you're using the app, to show nearby saved places and let you set up an arrival/departure reminder.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Veynlo uses your location in the background only to trigger reminders you've set for a specific saved place — for example, "remind me about X when I arrive at Y." It's never used to track or store where you've been.
plugins.locationAlwaysPermission: Veynlo uses your location in the background only to trigger reminders you've set for a specific saved place — for example, "remind me about X when I arrive at Y." It's never used to track or store where you've been.
